verdict.rationale: Three.js works with TypeScript and community evidence confirms it "works flawlessly with Typescript," but the typings are the community-maintained @types/three package rather than official first-party definitions, and users report function signature mismatches requiring @ts-ignore workarounds since the maintainer doesn't want to maintain them. No official LSP or first-party typed API is documented anywhere in the docs/GitHub evidence. Missing for 10: official first-party TypeScript definitions or LSP, documentation of editor completion/diagnostics support, and resolution of the reported type-mismatch gaps.
